SPARTAN
=======

.. figure:: _static/SPARTAN_logo.PNG
   :name: fig-SPARTAN_logo-4
   :alt: SPARTAN_logo.PNG
   


Software for single-molecule fluorescence and smFRET analysis (MATLAB).
